name: What preparation do I need to do regarding plumbing and electrical needs before starting an addition project?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do regarding plumbing and electrical needs before starting an addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting an addition, you should consider your current and future needs for water fixtures, appliances, and electrical outlets. Think about the desired location of sinks, toilets, showers, and any specialized electrical equipment like dedicated circuits for new appliances. Gather any existing floor plans or utility maps if available. This initial consideration helps inform the design team about your requirements, which is a crucial first step in our process for projects in San Francisco and surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before starting, consider your future water fixture and electrical outlet needs, and gather any existing utility maps to inform the design team.
